results.statement: For n>=2, every symmetric bilinear SO(n)-equivariant map S:R^n x R^n -> R^n is identically zero.
The parity-correct Cycle-092 repair can use a nonzero same-space vector-valued symmetric companion while retaining full SO(n) isotropy.

results.statement: A nonzero symmetric isotropic companion exists with scalar codomain, namely g(x,y)=<x,y>.
The same-space no-go and scalar/vector decomposition are historically novel to PDT.

results.statement: PDT derives a minimal scalar/unit augmentation and its composition law from independent distinction/resource primitives.
The augmented law survives associativity/grouping, quotient, resource and same-input tests without importing the quantum Jordan/operator product.
